parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, border/facility exclusion, or police targeting is documented; courts have ordered hotels and police to stop refusals and harassment, and protections for trans detainees have been recognised. Against this, armed groups in conflict-affected departments have issued kill lists and social-cleansing threats, trans women have been repeatedly threatened, displaced and killed, and accountability is described as little despite investigations and transitional-justice indictments. Raw killing counts lack a denominator and background homicide rate, so they are not treated as a measured trans-specific rate, but the patterned non-state targeting and conservative, divided society raise severity if outed, especially outside major cities. Subnational conflict regimes lower the mean score.
